notes.title: Small Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where launching the game with 0xp after ranking up would leave the most recent unlock locked.

notes.title: Pogo was off to a bouncy start
notes.content:
Pogo has hopefully recovered from the following issues:

   - Credits playing on startup.
   - Levels not unlocking as intended.
   - Bad steam input settings for non-xbox controllers.

All of these issues have been addressed and should be working correctly now.

To anyone still experience problems with controllers the settings should update shortly. In the meantime you can try disabling steam input in Pogo’s properties window if you are using an xbox controller or enabling it otherwise.

Thankyou to all of the early supporters out there for putting up with these hiccups. Keep bouncing!
